name: levelMode
label: Level mode
description: Restricts progression so each slide works as a level with exactly one scored activity.

fields.name: enabled
fields.label: Enable level mode
fields.description: Disables free slide navigation and unlocks only the next level. The summary slide remains available at the end.

fields.name: maxAttempts
fields.label: Maximum attempts
fields.description: The next level is unlocked when the activity reports success or this number of attempts is reached.

fields.name: automaticAdvanceDelay
fields.label: Automatic advance delay
fields.description: Time in milliseconds before advancing to the next level.

fields.name: buttonBottomSpacing
fields.label: Button bottom spacing
fields.description: Distance between the button and the bottom edge.

fields.name: buttonAppearance
fields.label: Advance button appearance
fields.description: Style for the Advance and Finish buttons. Border colors apply only when border is enabled.

fields.name: angle
fields.label: Gradient angle
fields.description: Direction in degrees (0 = upward, 180 = downward).

fields.name: borderRadius
fields.label: Button border radius
fields.description: Default is 2em (Joubel UI). Lower values are sharper; higher values are more rounded.

fields.name: showStatusMessages
fields.label: Show level status messages
fields.description: Shows locked, completed and remaining attempts messages in the level controls.

fields.name: levelBlockedMessage
fields.label: Locked level message
fields.default: Complete the activity to unlock the next level.

fields.name: attemptsRemainingMessage
fields.label: Remaining attempts message
fields.description: Use @attempts for the number of remaining attempts.

name: summaryAppearance
label: Summary slide appearance
description: Only affects the summary slide of this Course Presentation, not the embedded activities.

fields.name: actionButtons
fields.label: Summary action buttons
fields.description: Shared style for the Show solutions, Retry and Export text buttons. Border colors apply only when border is enabled.

fields.description: Direction in degrees (0 = upward, 180 = downward).

fields.name: borderRadius

name: navigationAppearance
label: Navigation appearance
description: Style for the progress bar in normal (non-level) mode. Does not affect embedded activities.

fields.name: style
fields.label: Navigation style
fields.description: Classic keeps the default Course Presentation bar. Dots replaces it with a compact point indicator.

fields.name: barBackgroundColor
fields.label: Override bar and footer background color
fields.description: Optional. When empty, the navigation bar and footer use the current slide background color.

fields.name: barWidth
fields.label: Bar width
fields.description: Width of the dots bar relative to the presentation.

fields.name: finishButtonEnabled
fields.label: Enable Finish button
fields.description: Only applies when Navigation style is Dots. When enabled, the summary slide stays locked until every task on every slide with a task has reported a top-level answered or completed statement. Nested questions inside a compound task do not unlock Finish. Default is off so free navigation is preserved.

fields.name: finishButtonAppearance
fields.label: Finish button appearance
fields.description: Style for the Finish button that unlocks the summary slide. Border colors apply only when border is enabled.

fields.name: borderRadius
fields.label: Button border radius
fields.description: Default is 2em (Joubel UI). Lower values are sharper; higher values are more rounded.

name: override
label: Behaviour settings.
description: These options will let you override behaviour settings.

fields.name: activeSurface
fields.label: Activate Active Surface Mode
fields.description: Removes navigation controls for the end user. Use Go To Slide to navigate. Summary is not available in this mode.

fields.name: hideSummarySlide
fields.label: Hide Summary Slide
fields.description: Hides the summary slide.

fields.name: showSolutionButton
fields.label: Override "Show Solution" button
fields.description: This option determines if the "Show Solution" button will be configured for each question individually (default) shown for all questions (Enabled) or disabled for all questions (Disabled)

fields.name: retryButton
fields.label: Override "Retry" button
fields.description: This option determines if the "Retry" button will be configured for each question individually (default) shown for all questions (Enabled) or disabled for all questions (Disabled)

fields.name: summarySlideSolutionButton
fields.label: Show "Show solution" button in the summary slide
fields.description: If enabled, the learner will be able to show the solutions for all question when they reach the summary slide

fields.name: summarySlideRetryButton
fields.label: Show "Retry" button in the summary slide
fields.description: If enabled, the learner will be able to retry all questions when they reach the summary slide. Be advised that by refreshing the page the learners will be able to retry even if this button isn't showing.

fields.name: enablePrintButton
fields.label: Enable print button
fields.description: Enables the print button.

fields.name: social
fields.label: Social Settings
fields.description: These options will let you override social behaviour settings. Empty values will be filled in automatically if a link is provided, otherwise all values will be generated.

fields.name: quote
fields.label: Share to Facebook quote
fields.default: I scored @score out of @maxScore on a task at @currentpageurl.

fields.name: statement
fields.label: Share to Twitter statement
fields.default: I scored @score out of @maxScore on a task at @currentpageurl.
